messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Rule today (2024): If the premium is paid in instalments during the policy period, coverage will be available for the grace period also.
Replaced rule (2020): Coverage is not available during the grace period.
Existing questions: ['If I pay my health‑insurance premium in instalments, will I still be covered during the grace period?', 'Does the insurer provide any coverage while I am in the grace period after an instalment payment?']
Write 2 NEW, differently worded questions (e.g. a concrete scenario with a policyholder) whose correct answer today is the 2024 rule. JSON: {"questions": [str, str]}

content: {"questions":["I missed my monthly premium due date but paid the installment a few days later; does my health policy still cover me during the grace period?","My insurer allows me to pay premiums quarterly; if a payment is delayed, will I remain covered while the grace period lasts?"]}
